title: Blogger XML Directives & Tags Master Catalog
description: Registry of Blogger XML directives, syntax grammar constraints, styling components, and attribute migration paths.

includable_resolution_hierarchy.description: Order-independent ontological specificity chain for subroutine resolution across static name and dynamic expr:name dispatch.

levels.name: gadget_specific
levels.description: <b:includable> inside <b:defaultmarkup type='WidgetType'> matching the widget type (exact or comma-separated multi-type).

levels.name: universal_widget
levels.description: <b:includable> inside <b:defaultmarkup type='All'>. Serves as widget fallback. Ignored in global template scope.

levels.name: shared_common
levels.description: <b:includable> inside <b:defaultmarkup type='Common'>. Base fallback for widgets, and exclusive subroutine source in global scope.

levels.name: platform_server
levels.description: Platform server inclusion catalog (super.* or un-overridden official inclusions).

levels.name: unresolved
levels.description: Subroutine not found across any ontological layer. Causes the Blogger engine to abort rendering of the host gadget with an HTML comment error: <!--Failed to render gadget '[WidgetId]'...-->.

target_resolution.description: Lexical traversal to find the nearest mutable HTML ancestor element.
target_resolution.widget_synthetic_wrapper_binding: Direct child mutations of <b:includable id='main'> bind to the synthetic widget root <div class='widget [Type]'>

page_skin.metadata_cleanup: Strip <Variable .../> and <Group>...</Group> tags from processed CSS

google_fonts_strategy.local_compiler_policy: Blogger production compiler inlines full @font-face stylesheets referencing fonts.gstatic.com. The normative local compiler adaptation replaces inlined @font-face blocks with a concise <link rel='stylesheet'> referencing fonts.googleapis.com in <head>.

1.name: Layouts v1 (Classic / Legacy)
1.description: Legacy XML layout engine supporting monolithic gadgets, table-based or legacy column formatting, and deprecated section constraints.

2.name: Layouts v2 (Transition)
2.description: Intermediate layout format introduced with responsive themes, adding mobile attributes and basic widget customization.

3.name: Layouts v3 (Modern Gadget v2)
3.description: Modern Blogger template standard supporting <b:defaultmarkups>, <b:with>, <b:template-script>, semantic section tags, and granular widget subroutines.

b:section.description: Container declaration for a theme section that can contain Blogger gadgets.

id.description: Unique identifier for DOM manipulation and Layout UI targeting.

class.description: Custom CSS classes. The engine always appends 'section' (and 'no-items' if empty).

name.description: Display label in the Layout GUI. Defaults to id if omitted.

tag.description: HTML element used for output ('header', 'nav', 'main', 'aside', 'footer', 'section', 'article'). Defaults to 'div'.

maxwidgets.description: Maximum allowed widgets. Deprecated in Layouts v3. Its presence causes the section to suppress widget rendering and emit <div class='no-items section'>.

showaddelement.description: Shows the 'Add a Gadget' button in legacy Layout UI. Deprecated in Layouts v3. Its presence causes the section to suppress widget rendering and emit <div class='no-items section'>.

preferred.description: Preferred section. Indicates whether the section is considered the main section. Values: 'yes' / 'true', 'no' / 'false' (default). Maintained for legacy compatibility, functional in modern themes.

cond.description: Render condition. If false, the section and its widgets are omitted.

ads.description: Set to 'true' (or 'yes') if the section is reserved exclusively for AdSense gadgets. Values: 'yes' / 'true', 'no' / 'false' (default).

growth.description: Deprecated layout alignment in legacy GUI ('vertical' default, or 'horizontal').

nesting.reason: b:section elements cannot be nested within another b:section or b:widget.

cdata.reason: b:section does not operate inside CDATA sections.

maxwidgets.reason: Deprecated in Layouts v3. In Layouts v3 (b:layoutsVersion='3'), its presence suppresses section rendering into <div class='no-items section'>. Remove this attribute.

showaddelement.reason: Deprecated in Layouts v3. In Layouts v3 (b:layoutsVersion='3'), its presence suppresses section rendering into <div class='no-items section'>. Remove this attribute.

growth.reason: Legacy horizontal/vertical layout hint in deprecated GUI.

populated_section.description: Emits an HTML wrapper element (defaulting to div or the tag attribute) with class 'section' (appended to any custom class) and id.

empty_section.description: Appends the 'no-items' class when the section contains zero rendered widgets at runtime.

b:widget.description: Container declaration for a Blogger gadget, containing its XML code and optional configuration structures.

id.description: Unique widget identifier consisting of the widget type followed by an integer from 1 to 999.

title.description: Display title shown in the Blogger dashboard Layout manager (max 100 characters). Optional during development: if omitted or declared empty, Blogger auto-inserts an empty title='' without raising a compile error.

cond.description: Conditional expression evaluated at request time. If false, the widget does not render.

locked.description: When 'true' (or 'yes'), prevents users from moving or deleting the gadget in Layout UI. Values: 'true' / 'yes', 'false' / 'no'. Default: 'false'.

visible.description: When 'true' (or 'yes'), the gadget is active and exposed in data:widgets global dictionary. Values: 'true' / 'yes' (default), 'false' / 'no'.

version.description: Gadget engine version: 1 (legacy) or 2 (modern). Rendered as data-version='...' on HTML container.

mobile.description: Legacy mobile template visibility filter: 'yes' (default), 'no' (desktop only), 'only' (mobile only).

pageType.description: Deprecated legacy view-type filter from v1 themes. Replaced by cond with data:view conditions.

nesting.reason: b:widget elements cannot be nested within another b:widget.

cdata.reason: b:widget does not operate inside CDATA sections.

inclusions.description: A b:widget must contain at least one b:includable with id='main'.

synthetic_wrapper_mutation.description: The synthetic container element (<div class='widget [Type]' data-version='2' id='[id]'>) generated by the compiler for each widget is susceptible to direct mutation via <b:class> and <b:attr> placed as direct children of <b:includable id='main'>, including effective overriding of its synthetic 'id' attribute.

mobile.reason: Mobile visibility control is active only for Version 1 gadgets.

pageType.reason: Legacy attribute used to control widget display on designated page types.

standard_wrapper.description: Emits an outer div wrapper with class='widget [Type]', data-version='[version]', and id='[id]' enclosing the evaluated output of <b:includable id='main'>.

suppress_when_empty.description: For widgets with runtime_rendering_policy='suppress_when_empty' (e.g. Label when data:labels is empty), suppresses the entire widget wrapper from the DOM.

server_forced_markup.description: For widgets with runtime_rendering_policy='server_forced_markup' (Followers), replaces custom <b:includable id='main'> markup with the server-rendered GAPI iframe payload in public views.

b:includable.description: Reusable template block that contains XML markup and can be invoked by a b:include tag.

id.description: Unique identifier within the enclosing widget. id='main' is the entry point.

var.description: Name of the scoped variable receiving the dataset forwarded by b:include data='...'. When omitted, forwarded payloads bind directly to the implicit root identifier data:.

widget.description: A b:widget must contain at least one b:includable with the id 'main'.

nesting.reason: b:includable elements cannot be nested within one another.

widget_wrapper_mutation.description: Direct child b:class and b:attr elements within id='main' directly mutate the widget's synthetic HTML root container element (<div class='widget [Type]' ...>).

b:include.description: Invokes a b:includable block and can pass a data alias or condition to the called inclusion.

name.description: Target includable identifier. Supports static names (name='sub'), dynamic expressions (expr:name='...'), and server defaults with prefix super. (name='super.sub'). In dynamic mode (expr:name), resolves via the 6-tier ontological hierarchy; if unresolvable across all tiers, the engine aborts host gadget rendering with an HTML error comment.

data.description: Dataset or object forwarded to the called includable. Strictly requires delimitation by curly braces { ... } (object literal or braced array) or a direct data object reference (data:post). Direct bracket arrays [ ... ] and primitive scalars (string, number, boolean) are rejected (BX1031).

cond.description: Invocation condition. If false, the inclusion is skipped.

data_payload.reason: The data attribute strictly requires an object reference, object literal { ... }, or brace-delimited array { ... }. Direct bracket arrays [ ... ] and scalar primitives (string, number, boolean) cause compiler rejection or runtime execution abort (BX1031).

data_alias.reason: Aliases must not contain the data: prefix.

alias_scope.description: The alias is passed to child inclusions and is overwritten when another alias is defined in a child node.

server_resolution.description: Server-hosted universal subroutines (all-head-content, urlParamsAsFormInput, etc.), common library subroutines (responsiveImageStyle, openGraphMetaData, widget-title), and super.NAME resolve against platform backend defaults and do not require local includable declarations.

dynamic_resolution.description: Dynamic includable dispatch resolves expressions (syntax expr:name='...') including static strings, string concatenations like 'widget:' + data:widget.type, ternary conditions, and member lookups against the canonical 6-tier ontological specificity chain. If unresolvable across all tiers, execution aborts the host gadget, emitting <!--Failed to render gadget '[WidgetId]'...-->.

data_shadowing_without_var.description: When data payload is forwarded without an explicit var attribute, an object literal { key: val } binds properties directly into the local data scope (accessible via <data:key/> or data:key), and an array literal { [k, v], ... } binds to the root data: iterator, while retaining fallback access to outer widget and global scopes (data:blog.*, data:view.*).

dom_mutation_hoisting.description: b:class and b:attr elements executed within the invoked b:includable hoist across the include boundary to mutate the enclosing HTML ancestor at the call site.

b:defaultmarkups.description: Container for defining default markup and inclusions specific to the current Blogger theme.

nesting.reason: b:defaultmarkups cannot be nested within sections, widgets, or other defaultmarkups containers.

cdata.reason: b:defaultmarkups does not operate inside CDATA sections.

b:defaultmarkup.description: Defines default inclusions for one or more gadget types or for common inclusions specific to the current theme.

type.description: Specifies the gadget type or types whose default inclusions are defined. Can also be 'Common' or 'All'.

nesting.reason: b:defaultmarkup must be placed directly inside b:defaultmarkups.

cdata.reason: b:defaultmarkup does not operate inside CDATA sections.

gadget_defaults.description: When the applicable gadget is installed or reset, the inclusions defined here are automatically added to the gadget.

override.description: Using the ID of an existing original inclusion overrides that inclusion.

creation.description: New inclusions can also be defined by using new inclusion IDs.

common.description: Using type='Common' defines shared base inclusions accessible from widgets (as base fallback) and the only inclusions accessible from the global template scope outside widgets.

all.description: Using type='All' defines universal widget fallbacks. Takes strict precedence over Common within widgets, but is completely ignored in global scope outside widgets.

multiple_gadgets.description: A single b:defaultmarkup can target multiple gadget types by listing their types as a comma-separated value (e.g. type='Blog,Header'). Resolves at the same ontological specificity as single-gadget blocks, with last-declaration-wins governing precedence among them.

precedence_model.description: Gadget-specific blocks (Exact/Multi) take strict ontological precedence over All and Common regardless of declaration order. In case of identical-type or container collisions, last-block-wins and last-container-wins apply.

b:widget-settings.description: Container for storing gadget settings defined by the user through the Blogger dashboard.

multiplicity.description: A b:widget can contain at most one b:widget-settings element.

generation.description: The element is generated automatically and cannot be created, deleted, or moved manually.

b:widget-setting.description: Storage element containing an individual gadget setting.

name.description: Predefined setting identifier specific to the enclosing widget type (e.g., 'showShareButtons', 'authorLabel').

multiplicity.description: Multiple b:widget-setting elements may be present.

generation.description: The element is generated automatically and cannot be created, deleted, or moved manually.

b:loop.description: Loop tag that iterates over an array and executes its child markup for each item.

values.description: The array or collection to iterate over. Literal array, data reference, or array-yielding expression.

var.description: Scoped identifier for the current item, accessed as data:VAR or data:VAR.property.

index.description: Scoped identifier for the zero-based iteration index, accessed as data:INDEX.

reverse.description: Reverses iteration order when expression evaluates to true (or truthy). Evaluates boolean literals, data paths, or dynamic expressions natively or with expr: prefix. Defaults to false. Does not reverse index numbering.

cdata.reason: b:loop does not work inside CDATA.

b:with.description: Instruction tag that creates a variable alias from an explicit value, data value, or Blogger expression for use within child nodes.

value.description: Expression, data reference, or literal whose resolved value is assigned to the alias.

var.description: Identifier name for the alias. Bound value is accessed downstream via data:VAR_NAME.

cdata.reason: b:with does not operate inside CDATA sections.

alias_scope.description: The alias is available through its variable name in child nodes.

b:if.description: Conditional control tag that executes its child markup when the specified condition evaluates to true.

cond.description: Condition determining branch execution. Boolean literal, data property, or expression.

cdata.reason: Conditional tags do not work inside CDATA.

nesting.description: b:if elements can be nested to create more complex conditional structures.

missing_cond.reason: A b:if without the cond attribute has no effect and is ignored by Blogger.

branches.description: A b:if container evaluates conditions sequentially with optional trailing b:elseif and b:else delimiters.

b:elseif.description: Conditional branch tag that evaluates an additional condition when the preceding b:if or b:elseif condition is false.

cond.description: Condition determining branch execution. Boolean literal, data property, or expression.

cdata.reason: Conditional tags do not work inside CDATA.

nesting.reason: b:elseif is a branch of a b:if chain and cannot contain child markup.

ordering.description: All b:elseif branches must precede any trailing b:else branch.

multiplicity.description: Multiple b:elseif branches may be used in the same b:if sequence.

missing_cond.reason: A b:elseif without the cond attribute has no effect and is ignored by Blogger.

b:else.description: Fallback branch tag that executes when all preceding conditions in the enclosing b:if sequence are false.

cdata.reason: Conditional tags do not work inside CDATA.

nesting.reason: b:else is a branch of a b:if chain and does not have its own condition or child markup.

multiplicity.description: At most one b:else branch may exist in a b:if sequence.

ordering.description: When present, b:else must be the final branch in the conditional sequence.

b:switch.description: Switch instruction that evaluates a value and executes the corresponding case branch when a matching case value is found.

var.description: The value or expression to evaluate and compare across cases.

cdata.reason: b:switch, b:case, and b:default do not work inside CDATA.

branches.description: A b:switch container requires at least one b:case child branch.

b:case.description: Switch branch that matches its value against the value evaluated by the enclosing b:switch.

value.description: Value compared against var. Supports dynamic expressions via expr:value.

cdata.reason: b:case does not work inside CDATA.

multiplicity.description: A b:switch must contain one or more b:case branches.

b:default.description: Fallback switch branch that executes when none of the preceding b:case branches match.

cdata.reason: b:default does not work inside CDATA.

multiplicity.description: At most one b:default branch may be used within a b:switch.

ordering.description: When present, b:default must be the final branch in the b:switch sequence.

b:tag.description: Dynamic XML instruction that generates an HTML tag in the rendered output, supporting conditional unwrapping and continuous mutation hoisting.

name.description: The HTML element tag name to render ('div', 'span', 'h1', 'article', etc.).

cond.description: Render condition. If false, the tag wrapper is omitted, but its child contents are preserved and emitted in the parent flow, and any child <b:class> or <b:attr> directives continue hoisting to the nearest enclosing HTML ancestor.

cdata.reason: b:tag does not operate inside CDATA sections.

name_attribute_conflict.description: The name attribute is reserved for specifying the generated tag name.
name_attribute_conflict.workaround: Use b:attr to add a name attribute to the generated HTML element.

unwrapping_hoisting.description: When cond evaluates to false, the tag itself is unwrapped, and child <b:class> and <b:attr> directives continue hoisting upward to mutate the next enclosing HTML ancestor.

arbitrary_attributes.description: Standard HTML attributes may be passed statically or dynamically via expr: (e.g., class, expr:href).

b:attr.description: Instruction tag that adds an attribute and its value to the parent element.

name.description: Target attribute name. Literal or dynamic (expr:name).

value.description: Target attribute value. Literal or dynamic (expr:value). If empty or non-existent, the attribute is omitted completely from the rendered DOM (no empty attr='' is emitted).

cond.description: Execution condition. If false, tag does not execute and attribute is omitted.

cdata.reason: b:attr does not work inside CDATA.

nesting.reason: b:attr elements cannot be nested within one another.

multiplicity.description: Multiple b:attr elements can be applied to the same parent element.

self_closing_parent.description: Using b:attr inside a self-closing element such as img, input, link, or meta causes an editor error; b:tag should be used to convert the element to a paired tag before adding b:attr.

b:whitespace.description: Declaring inside void elements (native like , , or dynamic via ) collapses inner whitespace, ensures clean self-closing void tag emission without trailing closing tags, and is never emitted as an attribute in the rendered HTML.

dom_mutation_pipeline.description: Hoists across arbitrary nesting of logic container directives (b:if, b:elseif, b:else, b:switch, b:with, b:tag) to add or overwrite attributes on the nearest enclosing HTML ancestor. Overwrites existing attributes on the target element (including the synthetic widget wrapper 'id'). When placed as a direct child of <b:includable id='main'>, directly mutates the synthetic outer widget wrapper element. Crosses subroutine boundaries (<b:include>) to mutate the caller's enclosing HTML element. If value evaluates to an empty string, the attribute is completely omitted from the resulting DOM. Discards attributes completely when cond evaluates to false.

b:class.description: Instruction tag that adds a class value to the class attribute of the parent element.

name.description: Target class name to append. Supports dynamic string expressions via expr:name.

cond.description: Execution condition. If false, tag does not execute and class is not appended.

cdata.reason: b:class does not work inside CDATA.

nesting.reason: b:class elements cannot be nested within one another.

multiplicity.description: Multiple b:class elements can be applied to the same parent element.

existing_class.description: Existing classes on the parent element are preserved when b:class adds a new class.

conditional_execution.description: When cond evaluates to false, the class is not added to the parent element.

dynamic_name.description: The expr:name form accepts a string data value or a Blogger expression whose result is a string.

overwrite.description: b:class adds a class to the existing class attribute rather than replacing it. Use b:attr to overwrite the class attribute.

dom_mutation_pipeline.description: Hoists across arbitrary nesting of logic container directives (b:if, b:elseif, b:else, b:switch, b:with, b:tag) to mutate the nearest enclosing HTML ancestor. When placed inside a b:loop, accumulates classes across all iterations on the enclosing HTML container. When placed inside <b:tag cond='false'>, continues hoisting to the parent HTML element. When placed as a direct child of <b:includable id='main'>, directly mutates the synthetic outer widget wrapper element (<div class='widget [Type]'>). Crosses subroutine boundaries (<b:include>) to mutate the caller's enclosing HTML element. Between sibling HTML elements, strictly binds to the ancestor container, never to adjacent siblings.

b:eval.description: Instruction tag that explicitly outputs the value resulting from a Blogger expression.

expr.description: The Blogger expression to evaluate and render. Literal values, data references, operators, or lambda expressions.

cdata.reason: b:eval does not work inside CDATA.

expression.description: The expr attribute can contain an explicit value, a data reference, or a Blogger expression.

indexed_data.description: When accessing an item by index, the existence of the corresponding data set should be verified with conditions before evaluating the expression.
indexed_data.reason: If the data set does not exist, the containing inclusion will not be executed.

missing_value.description: When the evaluated expression resolves to a missing or nullish value, renders empty output without emitting an HTML substitution comment.

not_singleton.output: <!--Substitution is not a singleton for tag [...]-->
not_singleton.description: When the evaluated expression resolves to a non-scalar container (object or array), emits a non-singleton substitution HTML comment.

data:*.description: Self-closing output tag for scalar data properties (recognized in parsers/linters by namespace prefix 'data:' matching any <data:PROPERTY_PATH/>; 'data:*' is documentation wildcard notation).

attributes.reason: data:* tags do not accept attributes.

array_index.reason: Array data cannot be extracted by index with a data:* tag.

expression_operators.reason: Expression operators cannot be used in a data:* tag.

object_item.description: Extracts an item contained in an object.

nested_object_item.description: Extracts an item through multiple nested objects.

missing_property.description: When the referenced property path is absent from the runtime dictionary (MISSING), emits an HTML comment indicating the missing tag path (without the 'data:' prefix).

not_singleton.output: <!--Substitution is not a singleton for tag [path]-->
not_singleton.description: When the referenced property path resolves to a non-scalar container (object or array), emits an HTML comment indicating the tag is not a singleton.

b:message.description: Tag that explicitly outputs a Blogger message data value. Dual closure mode: self-closing when unparameterized (<b:message name='...'/>) or a container when nesting b:param tags for parameter interpolation.

closure_mode.description: b:message is self-closing (<b:message name='...'/>) when referencing unparameterized system messages. It operates as a paired container (<b:message>...</b:message>) strictly when enclosing child b:param tags.

cdata.reason: b:message and b:param do not work inside CDATA.

nesting.reason: b:message elements cannot be nested within one another.

parameters.description: One or more b:param elements must be nested inside b:message when referencing parameterized messages. Parameter assignment is positional for simple tokens (%1), but pluralized ICU messages (e.g. numberOfComments with {numComments, plural, ...}) strictly require the 'name' attribute matching the ICU variable identifier (e.g. name='numComments').

direct_invocation.reason: Parameterized messages (authorSaid, authorSaidWithLink, byAuthor, byAuthorLink, numberOfComments, postedByAuthor, postedByAuthorLink, poweredByBloggerLink, templateImagesBy, templateImagesByLink) cannot be invoked via <data:messages.../> and strictly require <b:message>.

message_data.description: The name attribute is an alias for a Blogger data value of type message and must reference a valid message alias.

whitespace_separation.description: Sequential sibling b:param elements nested inside b:message must be separated by whitespace or newlines. Writing multiple b:param tags directly inline on the same line without whitespace (<b:param .../><b:param .../>) triggers an engine evaluation abort: 'Invalid parameters for message'.

b:param.description: Tag that supplies a parameter value to a parent b:message.

name.description: Optional parameter identifier (placeholder substitution is resolved positionally based on child tag sequence), except for messages.numberOfComments which strictly requires name='numComments'.

value.description: Value or expression to interpolate into the message. Accepts explicit literal values of any type via value='...' or dynamic expressions via expr:value='...'.

cdata.reason: b:param does not work inside CDATA.

nesting.reason: b:param is self-closing and cannot contain child nodes.

positional_assignment.description: Parameter replacement in b:message is resolved positionally based on child b:param order for simple messages (%1, %2), but strictly requires the 'name' attribute matching the ICU variable identifier for pluralized messages (e.g. name='numComments').

whitespace_separation.description: Sequential sibling b:param elements must be separated by whitespace or newlines. Concatenating sibling b:param tags directly inline without intervening spaces causes Blogger runtime evaluation to abort with 'Invalid parameters for message'.

multiplicity.description: Multiple b:param elements can be used within the same b:message.

b:skin.description: Required theme component that encapsulates CSS declarations and skin variables. Compiled by Blogger into <style id='page-skin-1' type='text/css'><!-- ... --></style> after substituting $(...) variables.

nesting.reason: b:skin cannot be nested inside sections, widgets, or includables. Blogger formats it as <b:skin/> and strips its CDATA contents upon saving.

cdata.description: b:skin CSS declarations and variable definitions must be enclosed in a CDATA section.

multiplicity.description: Exactly one b:skin element is permitted per theme.

compilation.description: Compiles into <style id='page-skin-1' type='text/css'><!-- ... --></style>. Variable references $(name) are substituted with effective values (value has precedence over default; type='font' decomposes into .family, .size, .style, .weight). Metadata tags (<Variable>, <Group>) are stripped from output.

b:template-skin.description: Theme component used for styles specifically applicable to the Layout tab of the Blogger dashboard. Emits <style id='template-skin-1' type='text/css'><!-- ... --></style> if not conditionally guarded; recommended practice is to isolate via <b:if cond='data:view.isLayoutMode'>.

nesting.reason: b:template-skin cannot be nested inside sections, widgets, or includables. Blogger formats it as <b:template-skin/> and strips its CDATA contents upon saving.

cdata.description: b:template-skin CSS content must be enclosed in a CDATA section.

version.reason: The b:template-skin tag is not allowed in Version 1 themes.

multiplicity.description: At most one b:template-skin element is permitted per theme.

serialization.description: Serializes into <style id='template-skin-1' type='text/css'><!-- ... --></style>. In production themes, wrapping with <b:if cond='data:view.isLayoutMode'> is recommended to omit it from public views.

Group.description: Optional container used to group multiple skin variables under a single menu in the Blogger Theme Designer.

description.description: Group label displayed in the Theme Designer UI. Supports multilingual system strings.

selector.description: HTML element or CSS selector targeted for real-time visual preview when adjusting values in the designer.

nesting.reason: Group elements cannot be nested within another Group.

cdata.description: Group elements must reside inside b:skin CDATA.

container_context.description: Group elements must reside inside a CDATA block within b:skin.

Variable.description: Declaration of a skin variable whose value can be configured through the Blogger Theme Designer.

name.description: Unique identifier (letters, digits, and dots .). Dots map to underscores in data:skin.vars.

description.description: Field label displayed next to the control in the Theme Designer.

type.description: Data type defining editor controls and value format (color, font, length, background, url, string, automatic).

default.description: Factory default value restored when user resets theme defaults or when value is omitted. Optional for type='string'; required for all other variable types.

value.description: Current active value taking strict precedence over default when present. Permitted to be empty ('') exclusively for type='string'; non-empty required for all other variable types.

color.description: Hex color code or name of another color variable for background variables.

family.description: Font family name for font variables.

size.description: Font size string for font variables.

min.description: Minimum length value in px for length variables.

max.description: Maximum length value in px for length variables.

hideEditor.description: Optional flag (defaults to false). When 'true' (or 'yes'), suppresses the interactive control from the Theme Designer UI. Values: 'true' / 'yes', 'false' / 'no'.

cdata.description: Variable declarations must reside inside b:skin CDATA.

container_context.description: Variable declarations must reside inside a CDATA block within b:skin.

string_variable_defaults.description: For type='string', the default attribute is optional and value can be empty (''). For all other types, default is required and value cannot be empty.

background_six_components.description: Background variable values must contain exactly six space-separated components: color, image, repeat, attachment (scroll/fixed), posY, posX.

automatic_variable_value.description: Variable of type='automatic' does not accept the value attribute; its value is computed dynamically by Blogger and stripped upon saving if present.

b:comment.description: Instruction tag that adds a comment to the Blogger template XML and can optionally render the resulting comment in the generated HTML.

render.description: Controls HTML emission. If true (or 'yes'), renders as an HTML comment (<!--...-->) without interior padding. If false, 'no', or omitted, stripped. Note: Standard XML comments inside <b:includable> are stripped at compile-time.

cdata.reason: b:comment does not work inside CDATA.

nesting.reason: b:comment elements cannot be nested within one another.

multiplicity.description: Multiple b:comment elements can be used in the same template.

expressions.description: Blogger expressions contained within the comment are evaluated before the resulting comment is generated.

render_true.description: When render evaluates to true ('true' or 'yes'), evaluates inner Blogger directives and emits an HTML comment without interior padding.

render_false_or_omitted.description: When render is false ('false', 'no') or omitted, strips the entire comment from the rendered HTML.

b:template-script.description: Instruction tag that loads a JavaScript file hosted by Blogger and associated with an official Blogger theme.

name.description: Internal asset identifier corresponding to the theme's official script bundle.

inline.description: When true or yes, the script contents are embedded inline in the document rather than linked via external src.

async.description: When true or yes, sets the async attribute on the generated script tag to load the bundle asynchronously.

scope.description: Designed specifically for official Blogger themes.

implementation.description: The syntax and behavior are determined by Blogger engineering for the requirements of its own themes.

file_compatibility.description: The referenced JavaScript file is designed to match the theme version and its update version.

script_url.description: The tag may generate a script element referencing the hosted JavaScript file.

script_content.description: The tag may explicitly generate the contents of the referenced JavaScript file.

CDATA.description: XML character data section that prevents its contents from being parsed, preserving special characters and preventing Blogger tags and expressions from being interpreted.

blogger_syntax.reason: Blogger-specific tags and expressions inside CDATA are not processed.

special_characters.description: Characters such as <, >, ampersands, and quotes are not escaped within the CDATA section.

b:skin.description: Commonly used inside b:skin to contain CSS without XML escaping or Blogger expression processing.

css.description: Can be used to write CSS without escaping XML-sensitive characters.

javascript.description: Can be used to prevent XML parsing of JavaScript containing special characters.

b:widget-setting.description: Can preserve special characters in widget setting values without XML escaping.
